title: The proper case: direct images of proper morphisms
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring annihilated by a positive integer $N$. Let $f:X\to S$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], where $S$ is of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and $N$ is invertible on $S$, as in [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions]. For every geometric point $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], write $X_{\bar s}=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose all these geometric fibres have dimension at most $d\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $F$ be a constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Then $R^qf_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is constructible on $S_{\mathrm{et}}$ for every $q\geq0$, and $R^qf_*F=0$ for $q>2d$.

proof.text: If the target S is empty, all sheaves on its etale site are zero. This proves both assertions in that case. Otherwise the positive coefficient annihilator N, invertible on the nonempty S, is also invertible on its ground field: a zero value in the field would be zero in every nonzero stalk on S. Use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] to identify the input constructibility conventions.

Apply [thm-fin-proper-constructibility-complete], using the source-library hasConstructibleDirectImages_of_isProper. It gives finite-stalk constructibility of every H^q(Rf_*(F[0])). The proved rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility identifies this sheaf with higherDirectImage at the stated nonnegative integer q. Apply the constructibility equivalence again to obtain precisely the finite-constant-value conclusion.

For a geometric point s given by the algebraic closure of a residue field, use proper bounded-below base change [thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below], with the torsion module-coefficient realization isIso_baseChange_of_isProper_of_isAddTorsion_ring. Exact pullback commutes with homology and with sheaves in degree zero. Thus s^*R^qf_*F is isomorphic to the q-th direct image of the restricted sheaf on the geometric fibre. The fibre is proper, hence finite type, over its algebraically closed field and has dimension at most d. The torsion cohomological-dimension bound [fin4-lem-fibrewise-cohomological-dimension], as realized by isZero_higherDirectImage_of_two_mul_lt, makes it zero when q > 2d. Only torsion coefficients are needed for this vanishing, and a finite ring is additive torsion.

Pullbacks along these geometric points jointly detect zero module sheaves by [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative]. Apply isZero_of_forall_isZero_upperStar_algClosurePoint to conclude that R^qf_*F itself is zero. This proves the node with the original coefficient hypotheses, geometric fibre bound and every binder unchanged.
